findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.configure.dev" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: configure_profile_read, configure_profile_remember, configure_profile_remember_many, configure_profile_forget, configure_profile_commit, configure_project_share, configure_profile_import · Private data: configure_profile_read, configure_profile_remember, configure_profile_remember_many, configure_profile_commit, configure_project_share, configure_profile_import · Public sink: configure_connect, configure_profile_remember_many, configure_project_share, configure_profile_import · Destructive: configure_profile_forget, configure_profile_import.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: configure_profile_read, configure_profile_remember, configure_profile_remember_many, configure_profile_forget, configure_profile_commit, configure_project_share, configure_profile_import · Private data: configure_profile_read, configure_profile_remember, configure_profile_remember_many, configure_profile_commit, configure_project_share, configure_profile_import · Public sink: configure_connect, configure_profile_remember_many, configure_project_share, configure_profile_import · Destructive: configure_profile_forget, configure_profile_import

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
